name: image_to_icns
description: Create short-lived browser sessions for local macOS ICNS conversion.

tools.name: create_icns_session
tools.description: Create a short-lived ICNS conversion session. Returns an editor URL where the user imports, crops, generates, and downloads an ICNS file locally in the browser.

tools.name: query_icns_session
tools.description: Read the current Session state and, after completion, the output byte length and ICNS representation count.

tools.name: cancel_icns_session
tools.description: Mark an active Session as cancelled using the secret from the editor URL fragment.

secret.description: The 128-character hexadecimal secret from the editor URL fragment.
